posts.author: kimmonismus
posts.text: A lot is happening at Google right now. Gemini 4 "Argon" hasn't even been released yet, and internally they're already testing the next Checkpoint, "Carbon," which is supposed to be approaching the level of Opus 5.5. It seems Google has found a way to overcome its internal hurdles and become competitive again.

posts.text: Andreessen Horowitz Backs Jev Maker at $7.5 Billion Value. TypeSafe AI, the startup behind Jev, a new artificial intelligence model that went viral after it launched only a few weeks ago, has raised about $870 million at a $7.5 billion valuation in a financing led by Andreessen Horowitz.
